entries.title: Numbers 34:1
segments: ¶Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 34:2
segments: "Command the children of Israel, and say to them: 'When you come into the land of Canaan, this [is] the land that shall fall to you as an inheritance-the land of Canaan to its boundaries.

entries.title: Numbers 34:3
segments: 'Your southern border shall be from the Wilderness of Zin along the border of Edom; then your southern border shall extend eastward to the end of the Salt Sea;

entries.title: Numbers 34:4
segments: 'your border shall turn from the southern side of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continue to Zin, and be on the south of Kadesh Barnea; then it shall go on to Hazar Addar, and continue to Azmon;

entries.title: Numbers 34:5
segments: 'the border shall turn from Azmon to the Brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the Sea.

entries.title: Numbers 34:6
segments: 'As for the western border, you shall have the Great Sea for a border; this shall be your western border.

entries.title: Numbers 34:7
segments: 'And this shall be your northern border: From the Great Sea you shall mark out your [border] line to Mount Hor;

entries.title: Numbers 34:8
segments: 'from Mount Hor you shall mark out [your border] to the entrance of Hamath; then the direction of the border shall be toward Zedad;

entries.title: Numbers 34:9
segments: 'the border shall proceed to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your northern border.

entries.title: Numbers 34:10
segments: 'You shall mark out your eastern border from Hazar Enan to Shepham;

entries.title: Numbers 34:11
segments: 'the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain; the border shall go down and reach to the eastern side of the Sea of Chinnereth;

entries.title: Numbers 34:12
segments: 'the border shall go down along the Jordan, and it shall end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land with its surrounding boundaries.'"

entries.title: Numbers 34:13
segments: Then Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying: "This [is] the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes and to the half-tribe.

entries.title: Numbers 34:14
segments: "For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received [their inheritance]; and the half-tribe of Manasseh has received its inheritance.

entries.title: Numbers 34:15
segments: "The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance on this side of the Jordan, [across from] Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise."

entries.title: Numbers 34:16
segments: ¶And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 34:17
segments: "These [are] the names of the men who shall divide the land among you as an inheritance: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun.

entries.title: Numbers 34:18
segments: "And you shall take one leader of every tribe to divide the land for the inheritance.

entries.title: Numbers 34:19
segments: "These [are] the names of the men: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;

entries.title: Numbers 34:20
segments: "from the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud;

entries.title: Numbers 34:21
segments: "from the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon;

entries.title: Numbers 34:22
segments: "a leader from the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli;

entries.title: Numbers 34:23
segments: "from the sons of Joseph: a leader from the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod,

entries.title: Numbers 34:24
segments: "and a leader from the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan;

entries.title: Numbers 34:25
segments: "a leader from the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach;

entries.title: Numbers 34:26
segments: "a leader from the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan;

entries.title: Numbers 34:27
segments: "a leader from the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi;

entries.title: Numbers 34:28
segments: "and a leader from the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud."

entries.title: Numbers 34:29
segments: These [are] the ones the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance among the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
